officialQueries.description: Existing read-only launch monitor; business definitions remain in the service repository.
officialQueries.notes: Read-only snapshot query, never refresh or push.

contract.appliesTo: Cumulative locked orders and user-car locked orders since launch for one explicitly requested vehicle generation (e.g. LS9). Not presale, retained orders after refunds, sales shares, or data refresh/push requests.

parameters.series: Generation explicitly named by the user, e.g. LS9. Do not infer a different generation from the current active phase.
parameters.cutoffDate: YYYY-MM-DD date portion of the prepared order_data cutoff (lock_time); use that snapshot date, not the current wall-clock date.
parameters.output: Unique absolute JSON filename under /tmp, including this ticket id; stdout is mixed Feishu card + JSON and is not the result file.

checks: When Prepare status is ready, its checksum, row count, cutoff, read-only permissions and freshness are already verified evidence. Do not rehash, stat or read parquet to re-probe these facts, and do not probe the environment or inspect CLI source before using the supplied argv. Validate only the requested scope and saved query result below; investigate data/environment only if the official entry fails or a concrete contradiction appears.
Top-level status must be success with no errors; inspect warnings before accepting the answer.
scope.filters.series and phase must match the requested generation and launch; metrics.as_of_date must equal cutoffDate.
Both counts must be present, numeric nonnegative integers; userCarLockedOrders must not exceed cumulativeLockedOrders. Do not compare against any hardcoded expected result.

Read the relevant metric definitions and business_definition time_periods[series].end and monitor sections. Launch date must match time_periods[series].end. Cumulative locked orders is not refund-adjusted retained orders; user-car is the order_type 用户车 subset computed by the official entry.
State the actual prepare data cutoff; report a relevant incomplete order_type warning without silently adjusting the official count.
investigateWhen: Entry fails, status is not success, warnings/errors occur, result file or fields are missing, selection is empty/ambiguous, or checks fail.

Requested metric, scope or definition is not covered by this contract or conflicts with required repository references. Investigate the specific conflict; a second full computation requires a concrete anomaly or definition conflict.
